headline: A real step up: the month now reads as one move with a goal, and the game is no longer blocking people. Nobody quit except Ruth (on the country picker). What holds scores at 6 is trust: the end screens and numbers sometimes contradict what the player did, the desk is still a lot to take in at once, and unfamiliar names are not yet explained.

loved.what: One clear move per month with illustrated cards and Helps/Hurts tags
The end-of-game reveal: stamp, seals, the truth table, the ranking ladder
Never blocked: reasons and fixes on the order cards, the seal meter that explains itself
The goal line and the result card saying what my choice did

patterns.title: The ending contradicts what I did
patterns.detail: Never Fired a Shot after ordering strikes; the truth table says no peace after Sign the ceasefire; a verdict that contradicts itself; Master Diplomat on a failed mission.

patterns.title: The country picker is a work form
patterns.detail: Pick a country opens a native dropdown of 41 names with unexplained numbers; hard on touch, impossible to type into. Ruth's quit point.

patterns.title: Numbers that disagree
patterns.detail: The same figure with different values in one debrief, tension credited to the wrong order, a forecast that contradicts the result, a green bar next to a red chip.

patterns.title: Still a lot at once
patterns.detail: Month 1 shows mission, crisis, three cards, cabinet pick, advisors, seals, budgets and a coach together; the briefing lists 7 goals with numbers; the result card is dense and looks the same every month.

patterns.title: Names I do not know
patterns.detail: 21 unknown-term flags (IRGC, Bandar Abbas, Rada, Pokrovsk axis...) while the learning aids are still being built.

patterns.title: What do I spend this on? How much does it do?
patterns.detail: Unspent political capital with no obvious big move (Olivia); cards show direction but not size (Dan wants plus or minus N before committing).

patterns.title: History has to stay plausible
patterns.detail: Anachronistic 1990 world events (Ukraine signing a pact with Denmark); midterms dated wrongly; Priya wants the middle months about the real Ukraine talks.

patterns.title: Late months go flat
patterns.detail: The last months become Execute on defaults; the result card art repeats; Leo wants more big moments mid-game, Marcus a branch from any month.

surprises: Olivia, the early quitter, finished her session (recommend 3 to 6).
Noah lost his mission by one point and still wanted to share the card, if it had not called him Master Diplomat.
The four personas who reached or chose the end liked the reveal most; Priya said she kept playing to see the debrief.
environment: Clean run: GPU rendering, 4 to 5 browsers at a time, no freezes. Several 'retry' frictions were label taps on card titles that the driver could not resolve (coordinate taps worked); logged as a harness item.
